title.zh: Chromium 多进程渲染地图与 RenderingNG 管线

description.zh: Chromium 将浏览器界面、Blink 渲染主线程（Parse→Style→LayoutNG→Pre-Paint→Paint）、合成器线程 cc 与 GPU 进程 Viz 彻底隔离，让合成滚动与动画无需等待主线程。
description.en: Chromium separates browser chrome, Blink's main thread (Parse→Style→LayoutNG→Pre-Paint→Paint), the cc compositor thread, and the Viz GPU process so scrolling and transforms stay responsive.

zh: 浏览器是怎么把网页画出来的
en: how Chromium renders a web page

title.zh: HTML 字节流解析、CSSOM 阻塞与预加载扫描
title.en: HTML byte stream parsing, CSSOM blocking & preload scanner

description.zh: 同步 script 会暂停 HTML 词法解析并等待前置 CSSOM 就绪，HTMLPreloadScanner 则在旁路提前扫描字节并并行拉取下游资源。
description.en: Synchronous script tags stall HTML tokenization until download, preceding CSSOM, and execution finish, while HTMLPreloadScanner scans ahead to fetch downstream assets early.

zh: script async 和 defer 区别

title.zh: 从右向左选择器匹配、SelectorFilter 与失效集

description.zh: Blink 从右向左验证关键选择器并靠祖先布隆过滤器在 O(1) 剪枝；修改类名时靠预编译失效集只把局部子树标脏重算。
description.en: Blink evaluates selectors right-to-left, prunes impossible ancestors in O(1) via SelectorFilter Bloom masks, and narrows class-toggle recalculation via InvalidationSets.

title.zh: LayoutNG 不可变片段与强制同步布局抖动
title.en: LayoutNG immutable fragments & forced synchronous layout thrashing

description.zh: LayoutNG 将约束空间转成不可变 PhysicalBoxFragment 供缓存复用，但在循环中先改尺寸再读 offsetHeight 会触发 N 次强制同步重排。
description.en: LayoutNG maps immutable ConstraintSpace inputs to cacheable PhysicalBoxFragments, whereas interleaving width writes with offsetHeight reads forces N synchronous reflows.

zh: 读写 DOM 交替为什么卡

title.zh: Pre-Paint 与四棵属性树（Transform / Clip / Effect / Scroll）

description.zh: Pre-Paint 将变换、裁剪、效果和滚动拆进四棵独立属性树，让 transform 与滚动只需在合成器改写单个节点而跳过排版与重绘。
description.en: Pre-Paint extracts Transform, Clip, Effect, and Scroll state into orthogonal property trees so cc handles transforms and scrolls by editing a single node.

zh: transform 为什么不触发重排

title.zh: PaintRecord 绘制清单与层爆炸陷阱
title.en: PaintRecord display lists & the layer explosion trap

description.zh: Blink 在 Paint 阶段只记录矢量指令块，由 PaintArtifactCompositor 压缩合并图层；若底层动画元素与后续卡片重叠，则会迫使卡片各自拆出纹理引发层爆炸。
description.en: Blink records vector PaintChunks squashed by PaintArtifactCompositor into shared backing layers, unless an overlapping promoted layer underneath forces every card above into separate GPU textures.

title.zh: TileManager 分块光栅化、双缓冲树与棋盘格

description.zh: cc::TileManager 把大图层切成 256×256 或 512×512 瓦片并在 PendingTree 光栅化后切换至 ActiveTree；滚动快过光栅吞吐时视口会暴露空白棋盘格。
description.en: cc::TileManager slices tall layers into 256×256 or 512×512 tiles rasterized onto PendingTree before activating to ActiveTree, exposing checkerboards when fast scrolls exceed throughput.

description.zh: 浏览器界面、主页面和跨域 iframe 分别提交只含 DrawQuad 的 CompositorFrame，由 GPU 进程里的 Viz SurfaceAggregator 缝合后送显。
description.en: Browser chrome, main frames, and isolated OOPIF subframes each submit CompositorFrames of DrawQuads that Viz's SurfaceAggregator flattens into one unified display frame.

title.zh: 主线程卡顿隔离：top/left 对决 transform/opacity
title.en: Main-thread jank isolation: left vs. transform

description.zh: 修改 top/left 必须每帧重跑主线程五阶段且受阻于 JS 长任务；由 CSS/WAAPI 托管给合成器线程的 transform/opacity 动画在 120 Hz 下可做到零丢帧。
description.en: Mutating left/top reruns five main-thread stages vulnerable to JS long tasks, whereas compositor-driven transform/opacity animations hold 120 fps uninterrupted.

title.zh: Skia Graphite、滚动驱动动画与 Speculation Rules 前沿
title.en: Skia Graphite, scroll-driven animations & Speculation Rules

description.zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月的 Chromium 渲染前沿：基于 Dawn/WebGPU 的 Skia Graphite 多线程光栅、线程化滚动驱动动画、跨文档 View Transitions 与投机预渲染。
description.en: Chromium's November 2026 rendering frontier: Dawn-backed multi-threaded Skia Graphite, compositor scroll-driven animations, cross-document View Transitions, and Speculation Rules prerendering.

title.zh: 网页卡顿或掉帧时先问的三件事
title.en: Three diagnostic questions for web page jank

description.zh: 对照 Performance 与 Layers 面板逐级定位：卡在主线程还是合成器 GPU、是否触发强制同步布局或非合成属性重排、以及是否发生层爆炸或瓦片棋盘格。
description.en: A practical DevTools triage checklist separating main-thread long tasks, forced synchronous layout, non-composited animations, layer explosion, and tile checkerboarding.
